_comment: PARTNER CONTENT PACKAGE. Everything referring to real people, the show's identity, and partner-specific rules lives here so it can be reviewed and replaced as a unit. Nothing in this file is approved yet. Display names are placeholders; no likenesses, logos, recordings, or music are used.

lines.bucket_intro: The bucket comes out. The room gets loud. Names start getting pulled.
lines.called_up: The host squints at the slip. "{stage}! Get up here!" The crowd turns to look at you. Somebody yells, "Look at {him}, {he}'s shaking!" You have one minute.
lines.not_called: The last name is pulled. It isn't yours. The show goes on, and you watch every set like homework.

low: The panel exchanges a long look.
Someone on the panel is quietly writing nothing down.
mid: The panel nods. A couple of real laughs in there.
The host leans into the mic: 'Okay. Okay. There's something there.'
high: The panel is laughing. The host slaps the desk.
Big applause. The band hits a sting on its own.

lines.redban_invite: Redban leans over after the interview: 'You should come do The Secret Show on Thursday.'
lines.golden_ticket: The host holds up a golden ticket. The room explodes.
lines.joke_book: The host hands you a joke book. 'Fill this up.'
lines.opening_offer: A panel guest catches you backstage: 'I've got a weekend at the Lantern. Want to open?'
lines.regular_intro: No bucket for you tonight. The host reads the lineup: "...and one of our regulars, {stage}!" The band kicks in. Remember: the panel expects new material.
